godpathSays.line: The System notes the synergy — foraged a plant new to this ground: +1 field XP.

🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (a raccoon with too many fingers, working at something, stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you, stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you, a red moon rising between the trees, breathing) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.

🚨 a raccoon with too many fingers, working at something, stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you, stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you, a red moon rising between the trees, breathing is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), the SYSTEM RELAY (if it can carry voices), or an ABILITY CRY (if your build has one). Each with honest costs.

📓 Journal: a raccoon with too many fingers, working at something, stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you, stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you, a red moon rising between the trees, breathing at the door, day 7.
🎁 "We watched your first week! You're good at... let us see..." (A gift awaits — choose an ability.)
◈ NEURAL CREEP — the overlay isn't on the world anymore. It's under it. Behind your eyes, faintly, when you blink.
⬢ SYSTEM: "Neural depth 52. I can hold more of you now — ability slots: 4."
🎁 "OH! You can hold more now! We've been HOLDING this — take it, take it, take it!" (The System's gift awaits — choose an ability.)
◈ CRISIS — THE BREACH. It got INSIDE. The haven was supposed to be the safe place — the one place. It isn’t.
◈ CRISIS — THE SIEGE. They came in the night for the pantry — and the village met them at the door with blades and fire and drove them back into the dark. Wealth has a scent. So does defiance.
SYSTEM: "INTRUDER REPELLED. The pantry’s aroma is now classified as a defensive liability. The audience is chanting the defenders’ names. Fan clubs are forming. This is how it starts."
⚔️ Ariki killed the red moon rising between the trees with their party — 2 rounds, 6 taken. Word travels fast. The village cheers.
✨ Ability gained: Survivor (L1). You endured. +10 max health.

◈ THE SPARK — something clicks. A trick Soo learned long ago suddenly has edges it never had. SYSTEM: "ANOMALY: organic unit demonstrates pattern recognition. Slot capacity increased. We are taking notes." (Ability slots: 4)
◈ THE MENTOR — Walt watches Soo work, then reaches over. "No. Like this." An hour later something has unlocked that no manual could teach. (Ability slots: 4)

◈ ARC III — ENGINES. SYSTEM: "VIEWERSHIP MILESTONE. Organic unit demonstrates compounding capability. Resonance protocols unlocked." — Your gifts deepen. Used in sequence, they resonate. The village is no longer just surviving. It is becoming something.
◈ SYSTEM: "RATINGS DIP. The audience wants STAKES — pointed ones. A PALISADE. Stockpile 14,000 kcal, 350 wood and 60 stone. Walls make such good television. You will thank us when the teeth come."
✨ Ability gained: Lucky Rock (L1). Your lucky rock. The System finds your faith adorable and helps a little: +5% on the hunt. (It’s not the rock. It’s you believing in the rock.)
◈ SYSTEM: "Ooh. NEIGHBORS. You know what neighbors are for? STORYLINES. Go knock — worst case, it's CONTENT. Best case? The show gets BIGGER."
◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience wants an encore. A trial, then — smaller this time, but televised." Haul 1,000 kcal to the pantry within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a lesson.
◈ THE TRIAL — the audience is restless. The System offers Soo a trial, broadcast live. Survive it and take the slot. Refuse it and... well. The audience remembers refusals. (Ability slots: 4)

◈ RESONANCE HARMONICS — SYSTEM: "HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED. Objects with high observer-attention waveforms function as auxiliary capacitors. We call this RESONANCE HARMONICS. We do not know why the waveforms taste like grief. We have stopped asking." — Hold a keepsake. Think about them. The System will do the math. (It is not math. It is love. The System will never know.) Channel keepsakes from your pack.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+6 integration)
⬢ SYSTEM: "Neural depth 67. I can hold more of you now — ability slots: 5."

◈ FLASHBACK — Photo Album
Faces from before. Yumiko's wedding. Your dad asleep in the chair. The neighbor's kid with the missing tooth. The most valuable thing you own, and it weighs nothing.

◈ "UNIT KNIFE ROLL — [TRANSLATION COMPLETE] — we have been watching you carry this. Attachment waveform: significant. Function decoded: +resolve when worn; camp cooking goes further. You knew it mattered before we did. Cute."

◈ FLASHBACK — Knife roll
The dinner rush, the pass, the tickets coming faster than thought. You survived your first Saturday service at sixteen. The roll was the prize.

◈ "UNIT DOG TAGS — [TRANSLATION COMPLETE] — we have been watching you carry this. Attachment waveform: significant. Function decoded: +resolve when worn (morale). You knew it mattered before we did. Cute."

◈ FLASHBACK — Dog Tags
Not yours. Wira's. You carry them so someone is remembered — the promise you made in the dust. Wira would laugh at you carrying them into the apocalypse.

◈ FLASHBACK — Tasting Spoon
Your first Saturday service, you were sixteen and the chef handed you this spoon without a word. Tap twice, taste, know. You still tap twice — the tickets are gone but the habit isn't.
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from Emberhold bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Assimilated. The overlay feels like home. That should probably worry you.
◈ THE CREEP — Soo's thoughts have an echo now. The System's echo. Or theirs. Hard to tell anymore. Gifts used in sequence resonate — try them together. (Ability slots: 5)
